ISTP>INTJ.title: Someone who tries things first, then plans ahead.
ISTP>INTJ.body: "Let's just build it and see" is something you say a lot. But after you build it, you've also decided what it's for. Even when building a bookshelf, you first test with leftover boards, then write down where it'll go and how many shelves in a notebook.
ISTP>INTJ.say: "I'll just build it first. I already know what it's for."
ISTP>INTJ.do: Before buying a phone, you compare specs and prices for days.
ISTP>INTJ.worry: When you lock in a plan, it somehow stops being fun. Some days you can't decide whether to stick to the plan or try the new idea.
ISTP>INTJ.karai: You decide whether to go out based on the last train home.
ISTP>INTJ.karai_s: You decide whether to go to the after-party based on the last bus home.
ISTP>INTJ.aru: You start a DIY project to "just try it," and before you know it, you've picked out the next tools to buy.
ISTP>INTJ.why: By nature, you're the type who touches things and tries them on the spot. Through experience, you also came to think far ahead and make plans. Thinking alone and deciding with logic are the same now. Actually working with your hands makes it clear what's possible, so your mind quickly moves on to the next plan based on how that felt.
ISTP>INTJ.yure: Your answers tend to change on the "facts or ideas" and "plan or go with the flow" questions. Answer as yourself in the middle of a project, or as yourself planning the week, and you may get a different result.
ISTP>INTJ.plus: You're torn because part of you wants to try things and part of you wants to plan. You're someone who actually makes your ideas real.
ISTP>INTJ.tip: After you make a plan, pick one thing you can do this weekend and just do it first. Once you try it, you'll quickly see what part of the plan to change.
ISTP>INTJ.hidden: Your temperament has a knack for checking things in person. It shows when you trust how something feels in the store more than online reviews. If you go see the real thing first, for shopping or for work, you'll make fewer mistakes.
ISTP>INTJ.hidden_s: Your temperament has a knack for checking things in person. It shows when you trust how something feels in the store more than online reviews. If you go see the real thing first, for shopping or for picking club gear, you'll make fewer mistakes.

ISTP>INTP.title: Someone who has to find out how things work.
ISTP>INTP.body: When your computer acts up, you start looking into how it works inside while fixing it. Even after it's fixed, you read article after article until you understand, "Why did that fix it?"
ISTP>INTP.say: "Fixed. Also, isn't this design kind of weird?"
ISTP>INTP.do: When you don't know something, you look it up yourself before asking anyone.
ISTP>INTP.worry: While you're still thinking, your interest moves on to something else. Once you understand something, you're satisfied and often forget to tell anyone.
ISTP>INTP.karai: On the train you wear earbuds so no one talks to you, with nothing playing.
ISTP>INTP.aru: Once you start watching videos of what's inside appliances, you can't stop, and suddenly it's midnight.
ISTP>INTP.why: By nature, you're the type who checks things by touching what's in front of you. Through all kinds of experiences, you also came to like thinking in your head about how invisible things work. Looking into things alone at your own pace has always been you. Once you understand one mechanism, the next "why" behind it comes into view, so there's never a good place to stop.
ISTP>INTP.yure: The only difference is "facts or ideas." Answer as yourself working with your hands, or as yourself lost in thought, and your result may go back and forth.
ISTP>INTP.plus: Your interest jumps to other things because you really want to know how things work. Not many people can fix something and also explain why it broke.
ISTP>INTP.tip: When you figure something out, tell someone, even in one line. Just saying "Hey, this is how it works" helps the people around you.
ISTP>INTP.hidden: Your temperament can also notice small changes. It's there when you hear that a friend's bike brakes sound different from usual. Say "Doesn't that sound weird?" early, and you can stop a problem before it gets big.

ISTP>ENTJ.title: Someone who leads the group and still takes on the hardest job.
ISTP>ENTJ.body: In meetings you quickly assign roles and take the hardest task yourself. When the meeting ends, you go back to your desk, put in your earbuds, and quietly work on the materials.
ISTP>ENTJ.body_s: In group projects you quickly assign roles and take the hardest task yourself. When the discussion ends, you move to a corner seat in the library and quietly work on the materials alone.
ISTP>ENTJ.say: "Bottom line first: we're passing on this one."
ISTP>ENTJ.do: Before a trip, you ask everyone's budget and do the math.
ISTP>ENTJ.worry: When you lead for too long, you lose your alone time and suddenly feel wiped out. You know it's faster to hand things off, but you still want to do them yourself.
ISTP>ENTJ.karai: When a friend asks for advice, you jump right to "So what do you want to do?"
ISTP>ENTJ.aru: Getting ready for a local festival, you give everyone a job, then go make the sign by yourself. That's when you feel most at ease.
ISTP>ENTJ.aru_s: Getting ready for the school festival, you give everyone a job, then go make the sign by yourself. That's when you feel most at ease.
ISTP>ENTJ.why: By nature, you're the type who works quietly alone with your hands and adjusts to the moment. Through experience, you also came to gather people, decide what's ahead, and move things forward. Deciding with logic hasn't changed since the start. Bringing people together is a role you took on later, and time spent alone working with your hands has always been when you feel most at ease.
ISTP>ENTJ.yure: Three of the four letters are different, so your result can change a lot. Answer as yourself leading a group, and you lean toward the people side. Answer as yourself on a day off, and you lean toward working alone.
ISTP>ENTJ.plus: You want to do it yourself because you want to really know what's going on. People trust a leader who doesn't just give orders.
ISTP>ENTJ.tip: When you hand off a task, say up front, "It's done when it looks like this." Once you can picture the finish, you'll feel calmer and less tempted to step in.
ISTP>ENTJ.tip_s: When you give someone part of the project, say up front, "It's done when it looks like this." Once you can picture the finish, you'll feel calmer and less tempted to step in.
ISTP>ENTJ.hidden: Your temperament can switch gears fast when plans suddenly change: "Okay, let's do this instead." You usually stick to the plan, so you haven't used it much yet. Use it on a day when things go wrong, and people will be really grateful.

ISTP>ENTP.title: Someone who builds the idea the same day they talk about it.
ISTP>ENTP.body: The same night you say, "Wouldn't that be cool?", you've already started making it. When a test version is done, you send a photo to friends and ask, "What do you think?"
ISTP>ENTP.say: "That's fun! Let's just make one first."
ISTP>ENTP.do: You learn new apps by tapping around, not by reading the guide.
ISTP>ENTP.worry: Talking with people gives you energy, but too much of it makes you want to hide at home. You have more ideas than time to build them.
ISTP>ENTP.karai: You meet up without picking a place, then look for one once you're there.
ISTP>ENTP.aru: Your room has several half-finished projects, and your family asks, "What's this?"
ISTP>ENTP.why: By nature, you're the type who checks things alone by touching them. Through all kinds of experiences, you also came to enjoy talking with people and expanding ideas. Thinking with logic and adjusting to the moment have been you from the start. When the next idea comes to you while you're still making something, you want to try that instead and switch over, so the number of unfinished things keeps growing.
ISTP>ENTP.yure: You may get stuck on the "energy from people" and "facts or ideas" questions. Take the test after a fun night out, or after a day working alone, and your result may change.
ISTP>ENTP.yure_s: You may get stuck on the "energy from people" and "facts or ideas" questions. Take the test after a loud class party, or after a day working alone, and your result may change.
ISTP>ENTP.plus: You want to do lots of things because you're curious about so much. Your hands start moving as soon as you get an idea, and that's a good thing.
ISTP>ENTP.tip: Before starting something new, finish one half-done project or decide to drop it. With less on your plate, it's easier to focus on the next thing.
ISTP>ENTP.hidden: You often get going by talking with people, but your temperament can also focus quietly alone. It shows on a quiet weekend morning when no one bothers you and your work moves fast. Make time like that on purpose, and you'll finish the things you started.

ISTP>INFJ.title: You remember the little things people mention in passing.
ISTP>INFJ.body: You don't talk much, but on days it looks like rain, you quietly bring two folding umbrellas. You remember something a person once mentioned liking, and casually give it to them on their birthday.
ISTP>INFJ.say: "I figured it might cause trouble, so I fixed it already."
ISTP>INFJ.do: On a friend's moving day, you show up with tools to help without being asked.
ISTP>INFJ.worry: You think so much about how others feel that you can't say what you really think. Some days you worry about what's coming and can't focus on what's in front of you.
ISTP>INFJ.karai: The day after hanging out with friends, you stay home, sleep, and talk to no one.
ISTP>INFJ.aru: You remember a coworker saying they were out of pens, and the next week you leave one on their desk. When they thank you, you get shy and say, "I just had an extra."
ISTP>INFJ.aru_s: You remember a classmate saying they were out of erasers, and the next day you leave one on their desk. When they thank you, you get shy and say, "I just had an extra."
ISTP>INFJ.why: By nature, you're the type who thinks with logic and acts quickly on the spot. Through experience, you also started thinking about people's feelings and even what might trouble them later. Valuing quiet time to think alone is the same now. You can show you care about someone through things, but saying it out loud has never come easily, so you get embarrassed when people thank you.
ISTP>INFJ.yure: Recharging alone is the only thing that matches, so your result can change a lot. The "logic or feelings" question especially depends on whether you picture yourself at work or thinking about someone you care about.
ISTP>INFJ.yure_s: Recharging alone is the only thing that matches, so your result can change a lot. The "logic or feelings" question especially depends on whether you picture yourself at school or thinking about someone you care about.
ISTP>INFJ.plus: You brush it off because you don't want them to feel they owe you. People are really grateful for someone who helps without expecting thanks.
ISTP>INFJ.tip: When someone thanks you, don't brush it off. Just say "Glad it helped." That alone makes it easier for them to ask you for help.
ISTP>INFJ.hidden: Your temperament can also stay calm and think with logic. It shows when an appliance suddenly stops and you calmly check the plug and settings one by one. Use this when friends come to you with problems, and you'll be kind and reliable too.

ISTP>INFP.title: Someone who can make what they imagine with their own hands.
ISTP>INFP.body: You get passionate talking about works you love, but your hands are calm when you're making something. You might spend days building a small model while picturing a scene from a novel you love.
ISTP>INFP.say: "Can I think it over on my own and get back to you?"
ISTP>INFP.do: When something you love breaks, you look up a repair video before you even feel sad.
ISTP>INFP.worry: You choose with your heart, then feel uneasy when you can't explain why. You can't put what you care about into words, so people often don't get it.
ISTP>INFP.karai: Asked about your day off, you say "I'll decide when I wake up," then never leave the house.
ISTP>INFP.aru: When someone asks how you feel, all you can say is "Nothing much." Then at night in bed, the words you wanted to say finally come.
ISTP>INFP.why: By nature, you're the type who handles things carefully and thinks with logic. Through all kinds of experiences, you came to let your imagination grow and value your own feelings. Moving alone at your own pace has always been you. The feelings are clearly there inside you, but putting them into words takes quiet time alone, so in the moment all that comes out is "Not really."
ISTP>INFP.yure: Your answers tend to change on "facts or ideas" and "logic or feelings." Take the test on a day you were absorbed in a hands-on task, or on a day you watched a movie you love, and you may get a different result.
ISTP>INFP.plus: Words don't come quickly because you don't want to say your feelings carelessly. So when they do come, they really reach people.
ISTP>INFP.tip: If you missed your chance to say something, it's fine to send a short "About yesterday..." later. Showing someone what you made is also a way to share how you feel.
ISTP>INFP.hidden: When everyone is panicking, you're the one who calmly asks, "Okay, what do we check first?" That's your temperament's way of thinking with logic. Use it when it counts, and people will start trusting you with important things.

ISTP>ENFJ.title: Someone who says "You can do it" and then actually helps.
ISTP>ENFJ.body: In front of everyone you say, "You can do it!", and then you take care of the detailed work alone. When a younger teammate is stuck, you say, "Let's do it together," and while you're at it, you rearrange the tools so they're easier to use.
ISTP>ENFJ.say: "If we all pitch in, we'll make it."
ISTP>ENFJ.do: When a friend is down, you take them out to eat and listen.
ISTP>ENFJ.worry: You're often out in front, so you run short on time alone. You listen well to others, but it's hard to say how you feel.
ISTP>ENFJ.karai: The one who fired everyone up is the one who most wants to go home.
ISTP>ENFJ.aru: At parties you're the one keeping things lively, but on the train home alone, you finally relax.
ISTP>ENFJ.aru_s: At class parties you're the one keeping things lively, but on the bus home alone, you finally relax.
ISTP>ENFJ.why: By nature, you're the type who works quietly alone with your hands. Through experience, you also came to cheer people on and lead from the front. Your temperament and character differ in all four letters, so you seem quite different in front of people and alone. Getting people going is a role you learned through experience, so when it's over and you're alone, you finally get back to your own pace and feel relieved.
ISTP>ENFJ.yure: All four letters are different, so your result can change a lot. Answer as yourself on a day in front of people, or on a day working alone, and you may get a different type. Both are you.
ISTP>ENFJ.plus: Feeling relaxed when you're alone means you know how to rest. When someone who actually helps says "You can do it," people believe it.
ISTP>ENFJ.tip: Before and after an event, put some alone time on your calendar first. When your rest time is set, you can stay upbeat until the very end.
ISTP>ENFJ.hidden: Your temperament can focus quietly on its own. It shows when you're working alone and notice smaller details than usual. Before a day when you'll be in front of people, set aside a little of this time, and you'll feel calmer.

ISTP>ENFP.title: Someone who's quick to say "Sure, let's go!"
ISTP>ENFP.body: When you're talking with friends you're the loudest one, but when something breaks you suddenly get quiet and start fixing it. On trips too, you suggest on a whim, "Let's try this way," and when you get lost, you quietly find the way on your phone's map.
ISTP>ENFP.say: "Sounds good, let's go! We can figure out the details when we get there."
ISTP>ENFP.do: On a trip, you ask locals for tips and change your plans on the spot.
ISTP>ENFP.worry: After a fun chat, you suddenly want to be alone. You want to do so many things that you often start the next one before finishing the last.
ISTP>ENFP.karai: You said "I'll go if I can," and then you're the first one there.
ISTP>ENFP.aru: You were the most excited one at the campsite, but on the drive home you suddenly go quiet. You're just tired, not upset.
ISTP>ENFP.why: By nature, you're the type who checks things quietly alone and thinks with logic. Through all kinds of experiences, you also came to get excited with people and value feelings. Moving with the flow of the moment hasn't changed since the start. Having fun with people uses up energy, and you quietly get it back in the car on the way home, so going quiet doesn't mean you're in a bad mood.
ISTP>ENFP.yure: Going with the flow is the only part that matches, so your result can change easily. Take it right after hanging out with friends, and you may get an outgoing type. Take it after a day working alone, and you may get a quieter one.
ISTP>ENFP.plus: You go quiet on the way home because you're resting after having so much fun. You have fun when it's time for fun, and rest when you're tired.
ISTP>ENFP.tip: If you think you'll go quiet on the way home, say "I'm just a little tired" ahead of time. That one line keeps your friends from worrying.
ISTP>ENFP.hidden: At a barbecue, while everyone is chatting, you've already got the fire going. Your temperament is good with tools. Show this side more, and people will see you as fun and also someone they can count on.

ISTP>ISTJ.title: Someone who sticks to the steps once they decide to do something.
ISTP>ISTJ.body: You say firmly, "We'll start at 10 as planned," but when rain changes the plans, you think of another place to go right away. You keep your work steps in notes, but when you find a faster way, by the next day you've rewritten the notes.
ISTP>ISTJ.say: "We meet at ten. If you're running late, let me know first."
ISTP>ISTJ.do: Before you hand in work, you check the numbers against last year's.
ISTP>ISTJ.do_s: Before you hand in an assignment, you check it against the textbook and old handouts.
ISTP>ISTJ.worry: You're good at following rules, but too many of them make you feel boxed in. On days off, you tend to pack your schedule too full or leave it totally empty.
ISTP>ISTJ.karai: You skip the long group-chat messages and only check the date, time and place.
ISTP>ISTJ.aru: You set the trip times exactly, but on the day you think, "That road looks nice," and want to take a detour.
ISTP>ISTJ.why: By nature, you're the type who changes how you move by watching the situation. Through experience, you also came to make plans ahead and follow them. Thinking alone and deciding with logic based on facts have been you from the start. Making plans puts you at ease, but when a good-looking path appears in front of you, the urge to check it out on the spot is still there too.
ISTP>ISTJ.yure: Answer as yourself on a workday and you'll lean toward planning. Answer as yourself on a day off and you'll lean toward going with the flow. "Plan or go with the flow" is the only difference, so you may go back and forth between two types.
ISTP>ISTJ.yure_s: Answer as yourself on a school day and you'll lean toward planning. Answer as yourself on a day off and you'll lean toward going with the flow. "Plan or go with the flow" is the only difference, so you may go back and forth between two types.
ISTP>ISTJ.plus: You want detours because you can think on your feet. Someone who prepares well and can handle sudden trouble is someone people rely on.
ISTP>ISTJ.plus_s: You want detours because you can think on your feet. Someone who prepares well and can handle sudden trouble is someone your club and class rely on.
ISTP>ISTJ.tip: When you plan a trip or a day off, add one hour with nothing planned. Then a detour is still "on schedule," and you can enjoy it without stress.
ISTP>ISTJ.hidden: Your temperament can act fast when things change. It shows when the projector suddenly stops in a meeting and you calmly fix it. Use this on days full of last-minute changes, and the people around you will calm down too.
ISTP>ISTJ.hidden_s: Your temperament can act fast when things change. It shows when the projector suddenly stops in class and you calmly fix it. Use this on days full of last-minute changes, and the people around you will calm down too.

ISTP>ISFJ.title: Someone who quietly fixes things at home when they break.
ISTP>ISFJ.body: When a light bulb at home burns out, you've already replaced it before anyone notices. You also keep an eye on how much detergent and tissues are left, and quietly buy more before they run out.
ISTP>ISFJ.say: "It's getting cold. Take this with you."
ISTP>ISFJ.do: For family birthdays, you remember what they liked last year and shop at the same store.
ISTP>ISFJ.worry: You can do what people ask so easily that you can't say no. Before you know it, your own time keeps shrinking.
ISTP>ISFJ.karai: Once you find a regular spot, you order the same thing every time.
ISTP>ISFJ.aru: You spent your day off taking care of family errands, and there was no time left for what you wanted to do.
ISTP>ISFJ.why: By nature, you're the type who thinks with logic and quickly works with your hands on the spot. Through experience, you also started thinking about how your family and the people around you feel and preparing ahead. Recharging in time alone is the same now. When you notice something is wrong, your hands move right away, and your wish to do it for them is strong too, so you put family errands ahead of your own time.
ISTP>ISFJ.yure: Your answers tend to change on "logic or feelings" and "plan or go with the flow." If you answer as yourself helping your family, you're more likely to get a type that values feelings and planning ahead.
ISTP>ISFJ.plus: You can act before anyone asks because you pay close attention. Being asked so often that you can't say no means people really count on you.
ISTP>ISFJ.tip: Pick one "hobby day" a week and tell your family ahead of time. If you save favors for other days, you'll keep some time for yourself.
ISTP>ISFJ.hidden: When your family argues, can you ask each person, one at a time, "So what's the problem for you?" Your temperament can also stay calm and think with logic. Use it, and people will count on you to help sort things out.

ISTP>ESTJ.title: Someone who sets the plan and fixes problems themselves.
ISTP>ESTJ.body: After telling everyone their roles, you take on the most tedious task yourself. You set how the meeting will run, and when the projector won't turn on, you're the first to go check the cables.
ISTP>ESTJ.body_s: After telling everyone their roles, you take on the most tedious task yourself. You set how the committee meeting will run, and when the mic acts up, you're the first to go fix it.
ISTP>ESTJ.say: "Here's how we'll split the roles. Send any problems my way."
ISTP>ESTJ.do: You reuse whatever worked last time on the next job.
ISTP>ESTJ.do_s: You reuse whatever worked last time on the next assignment.
ISTP>ESTJ.worry: The more you're asked to lead, the less time you get to work alone. You want others to stick to the plan, but sometimes you want to act on a whim yourself.
ISTP>ESTJ.karai: When buying an appliance, you study the spec numbers so closely that you forget to pick a color.
ISTP>ESTJ.aru: Somehow you ended up running the neighborhood event, but when the mic acts up, you're the one who goes to fix it.
ISTP>ESTJ.aru_s: Somehow you ended up running the school sports day, but when the mic acts up, you're the one who goes to fix it.
ISTP>ESTJ.why: By nature, you're the type who works quietly alone and adjusts to the moment. Through experience, you also came to stand in front of people and run things by the plan. Deciding with logic based on facts has always been you. Even when you're the one in charge, when something stops working right in front of you, your longtime strength of fixing it with your own hands comes out first.
ISTP>ESTJ.yure: Your answers tend to change on "energy from people" and "plan or go with the flow." You may get different results depending on whether you picture a day with a job to do or a free day off.
ISTP>ESTJ.plus: You end up going to fix things yourself because you notice right away where help is needed. Not many people can see the whole picture and still get their hands dirty.
ISTP>ESTJ.tip: On days you're in charge, before going to fix something yourself, ask once, "Can someone take a look?" If you can hand it off, you'll have time to watch the whole thing.
ISTP>ESTJ.hidden: On days off, do you ever lose track of time taking care of your tools alone? By nature, you're good at quietly working with your hands on your own. Make room for that time, and you'll build up more things you're really good at.

ISTP>ESFJ.title: Someone who looks around and asks, "Everyone have a drink?"
ISTP>ESFJ.body: At get-togethers you ask, "Does everyone have enough to drink?", and if a chair is wobbly, you quietly fix it. The day before, you get paper cups and ice for everyone, and prepare extra so nothing runs out.
ISTP>ESFJ.say: "That light's not working. I'll go take a look."
ISTP>ESFJ.do: You remember a place a friend once said they liked, and take them there when you meet.
ISTP>ESFJ.worry: After looking after people at a get-together, you want to be quiet on your own. Even when you want to say, "I don't think that's right," you think of the mood and keep it in.
ISTP>ESFJ.karai: At get-togethers, you don't eat. You keep an eye on everyone's plates instead.
ISTP>ESFJ.aru: At a get-together at a friend's place, you have a good time while keeping an eye on everyone's drinks. Once you get home, you're suddenly worn out.
ISTP>ESFJ.why: By nature, you're the type who quietly checks things alone and thinks with logic. Through experience, you also came to look out for people and prepare ahead of time. Now acting for others comes naturally. Looking out for people is something you picked up through experience, so even when it's fun, you use a lot of energy, and the tiredness hits the moment you're alone.
ISTP>ESFJ.yure: Three parts besides "facts" tend to change, so your result can shift a lot. Answer as yourself hosting people, and you'll lean toward an outgoing, caring type. Answer as yourself working alone, and you'll lean toward a quieter type.
ISTP>ESFJ.plus: You feel relieved on the way home because you were looking after everyone that much. You know how to rest alone, so you can go back to people again.
ISTP>ESFJ.tip: After plans with people, leave a little time to space out alone. If you don't let tiredness pile up, you'll enjoy the next time more too.
ISTP>ESFJ.hidden: When the group can't agree, you can ask, "So which one is fastest?" That's your temperament's way of deciding with logic. Use it, and people will count on you to make the call when it matters.

ISTP>ISTP.title: Someone who skips the manual and just tries it.
ISTP>ISTP.body: You figure things out by trying them with your own hands. When your bike isn't working right, you first take a look yourself before taking it to a shop. With new appliances too, the manual stays in the box, and you learn how to use them by pressing buttons.
ISTP>ISTP.do: When you buy furniture, you put it together barely looking at the instructions.
ISTP>ISTP.worry: Putting feelings into words is hard for you, so people say, "I can't tell what you're thinking." When someone gives you lots of detailed instructions, you suddenly lose interest.
ISTP>ISTP.karai: Your texts are mostly just "Got it" and "OK."
ISTP>ISTP.aru: Someone asked, "You okay?" You just said, "Yeah," and the conversation ended there. You thought you'd answered just fine.
ISTP>ISTP.why: Your temperament and character are the same in all four letters: by nature, you're the type who focuses alone, thinks with logic, and acts. Even with all kinds of experiences, being better with your hands than with words hasn't changed. You feel it's enough to say what's needed briefly. You feel you've properly answered a question with "Yeah," so it's hard for you to notice when the other person wanted to talk more.
ISTP>ISTP.yure: You'll likely get almost the same result every time. If a different type shows up, you may be in a stretch of rule-heavy work or going along with others a lot.
ISTP>ISTP.yure_s: You'll likely get almost the same result every time. If a different type shows up, you may be in a stretch of rule-heavy club practice or going along with others a lot.
ISTP>ISTP.plus: You don't say much because you skip what doesn't need saying. When you say "Done," people relax.
ISTP>ISTP.tip: When you take on something someone asked, add one line like, "I'll have it done by Friday." That way they can relax while they wait.
ISTP>ISTP.hidden: You don't say much, but you do care how people feel. When a friend is having a hard time, don't you just quietly help? Add a quick "Want a hand?" and it'll come across even better.

ISTP>ISFP.title: Someone who, in the end, picks what they like.
ISTP>ISFP.body: When building a shelf, you measure precisely, but you agonize over choosing the final color. Even when shopping, you compare specs in detail, but in the end you decide by how it feels in your hand.
ISTP>ISFP.say: "Can I touch it first before I decide?"
ISTP>ISFP.do: On days off, you check the weather after you wake up and then decide where to go.
ISTP>ISFP.worry: Even when you know something makes sense, you can't move if your heart isn't in it. When you share your opinion, you worry it sounds cold.
ISTP>ISFP.karai: You say you're not picky, but you spend weeks choosing a phone case.
ISTP>ISFP.aru: A friend asks, "Why did you pick that one?" and all you can say is, "Because I like it."
ISTP>ISFP.why: By nature, you're the type who compares with logic and decides. Through all kinds of experiences, you also came to make decisions that value your own feeling of "I like this." Moving alone while checking what's in front of you hasn't changed since the start. The final deciding factor isn't logic but your own feelings, so when you try to explain it to someone, you can't find any words besides "Because I like it."
ISTP>ISFP.yure: The only difference is "logic or feelings." Answer as yourself working on something, and you'll lean toward logic. Answer as yourself picking a gift, and you'll lean toward feelings.
ISTP>ISFP.plus: You pick by color in the end because what you like matters to you too. That's why you take good care of what you choose and use it for a long time.
ISTP>ISFP.tip: Before you give your opinion, try adding "Personally, I like it, but..." People will hear it as your taste, so it won't sound as cold.
ISTP>ISFP.hidden: When a friend can't decide, you can quickly lay out the good and bad points of each choice. That's your temperament's way of thinking with logic. Use it, and you'll be someone people find easy to go to for advice.

ISTP>ESTP.title: Someone who moves first when something goes wrong.
ISTP>ESTP.body: When trouble comes up on an outing with friends, you're already moving before everyone talks it over. You often go outdoors with friends on weekends, yet on weeknights you spend your evenings alone taking care of your gear.
ISTP>ESTP.say: "Let's just try it. If it doesn't work, we'll change it."
ISTP>ESTP.do: When you get lost, you don't ask anyone. You find a shortcut on your phone's map.
ISTP>ESTP.worry: Being with people is fun, but after a while you suddenly want to be alone. People usually say "You should've asked me first" after it's already done.
ISTP>ESTP.karai: You say, "Let me take a look," and by the time you're back, it's already fixed.
ISTP>ESTP.aru: When you go out with friends, you keep things fun and lively. But back home, you think alone about what you should have done differently.
ISTP>ESTP.why: By nature, you're the type who recharges by resting alone. Through experience, you also came to get energy from times of having fun with people. Looking at the facts in front of you and acting right away on the spot have been you from the start. While you're with people, you're absorbed in enjoying the moment, and only once you're alone can you calmly look back on what you did that day.
ISTP>ESTP.yure: Your answer to "energy from people or recharge alone" may change between busy social weeks and weeks spent working alone. You may go back and forth between two types.
ISTP>ESTP.plus: After a busy day, you can look back on it by yourself. That's why you do even better next time.
ISTP>ESTP.tip: If people often say "You should've asked first," send a quick "I'm going to do this now" before you start. That alone puts people at ease.
ISTP>ESTP.hidden: When you work quietly alone, you notice smaller details than usual. That's your temperament's ability to focus by yourself. Make time for it on purpose, and you'll get even better at what you're good at.

ISTP>ESFP.title: You goof around, but you're the one to count on when trouble hits.
ISTP>ESFP.body: Even when you're having the most fun at karaoke, you go check right away if the machine acts up. When everyone cooks together, you chat away while keeping a close eye on the heat and timing.
ISTP>ESFP.say: "We came all this way, let's check out over there too."
ISTP>ESFP.do: When shopping, you'll buy something you didn't plan on if you try it and like it.
ISTP>ESFP.worry: The day after a fun time with people, you're wiped out and don't want to talk to anyone. You can't decide whether to say what you think or keep the fun mood.
ISTP>ESFP.karai: You stay till the very end, then sleep until noon the next day.
ISTP>ESFP.aru: You were snapping photos and having a blast on the trip, but the moment you got lost, you put on a serious face and checked the map.
ISTP>ESFP.why: By nature, you're the type who checks things alone and thinks with logic. Through all kinds of experiences, you also came to get energy among people and value everyone's feelings. Looking at what's in front of you and acting on the spot are the same now. When things are fun, you're having a blast with everyone, but when trouble comes up, your original ability to calmly check things comes to the front.
ISTP>ESFP.yure: Whether you picture yourself at a trip or festival, or on a day spent alone with your hobby, changes your answers on "people or alone" and "logic or feelings." So your result can change easily too.
ISTP>ESFP.plus: You can calm down fast because you keep an eye on things even while having fun. You're the one who livens things up and the one people can count on.
ISTP>ESFP.tip: Once the trouble is handled, say "We're good now, let's keep having fun." That one line brings the good mood right back.
ISTP>ESFP.hidden: Your temperament can also recharge quietly alone. It shows when you feel relaxed looking back through photos by yourself the day after a busy trip. Take care of that time, and you'll enjoy seeing people again next time.

ISFP>INTJ.title: Someone who plans carefully to collect the things they love.
ISFP>INTJ.body: Once you decide where you want to travel, you save a little money at a time for months ahead. You also remember when your favorite brand releases new items and plan your monthly spending around that.
ISFP>INTJ.say: "I'd like to take it easy at home today."
ISFP>INTJ.do: Before buying furniture, you measure the room and even think about how many years you'll use it.
ISFP>INTJ.do_s: Before buying a backpack, you check what will fit and even think about how many years you'll use it.
ISFP>INTJ.worry: Making a plan helps you relax, but as you follow it, the "I love this" feeling starts to fade. When someone asks why you picked something on a hunch, you can't really answer.
ISFP>INTJ.karai: You say you picked it "just because," but you did quite a bit of research before buying.
ISFP>INTJ.aru: You only bought one mug in your favorite color, but now you're thinking of matching the curtains and cushions too.
ISFP>INTJ.why: By nature, you're the type who values comfort in the moment and chooses by feeling. Through experience, you also came to look ahead and make plans with logic. Recharging in time alone has always been you. The feeling "I love this" becomes a starting point, and your mind keeps racing ahead to how to spread it to your whole room.
ISFP>INTJ.yure: Apart from recharging alone, all three other parts are different, so your result can change a lot. Answer as yourself planning at work, and you'll get a planner type. Answer as yourself enjoying your favorite things on a day off, and you'll get a type that follows your mood.
ISFP>INTJ.yure_s: Apart from recharging alone, all three other parts are different, so your result can change a lot. Answer as yourself planning your studying for a test, and you'll get a planner type. Answer as yourself enjoying your favorite things on a day off, and you'll get a type that follows your mood.
ISFP>INTJ.plus: A small purchase turns into a big plan because you want to take good care of what you love. You're someone who can enjoy your favorite things for a long time.
ISFP>INTJ.tip: Add one "change it if I feel like it" day to your plan. If you decide ahead that the plan can change when your tastes change, things feel easier.
ISFP>INTJ.hidden: On a free day, have you ever wandered into a shop and found something you love? Your temperament knows how to go with the flow. You usually stick to plans, so this hasn't come out much yet. Head out sometimes without a plan, and you'll find new things to love.

ISFP>INTP.title: Someone who gets really into the things they love.
ISFP>INTP.body: You look into things that interest you until you're satisfied. When you find a singer you like, you look up not just the songs but the instruments they use and how they record. When you see clothes in a beautiful color, you start thinking, "What would go well with this?"
ISFP>INTP.say: "I think I'll decide today's plans after I get up."
ISFP>INTP.do: When you eat something delicious at a restaurant, you try making it at home again and again.
ISFP>INTP.worry: Some days you think so much that you can't just enjoy things. You don't talk until your thoughts are sorted, so people assume you're not thinking about anything.
ISFP>INTP.karai: You go into a gift shop to "just take a look," and you don't come out for ages.
ISFP>INTP.aru: After crying over a song you love, you start looking up "Why does this song make me cry?" and suddenly it's the middle of the night.
ISFP>INTP.why: By nature, you're the type who takes in the colors and sounds in front of you and decides by feeling. Through all kinds of experiences, you also came to think about how things work and check them with logic. Moving alone at your own pace hasn't changed since the start. You want to know for yourself why something moved you, so right after being moved, you start looking into how it works.
ISFP>INTP.yure: Two things differ between your temperament and your character: whether you look at facts or ideas, and whether you decide with logic or feelings. Your result can change depending on whether you picture yourself enjoying something you love or thinking something over.
ISFP>INTP.plus: You want to know why because you want to know more about what you love. You can put what's good about it into words, so your recommendations get through to people.
ISFP>INTP.tip: When you talk about something you love, start with "It was so good." Once your feeling comes across first, people are happy to hear the details.
ISFP>INTP.hidden: By nature, you notice small differences in how things look and feel. Have you ever noticed right away that a friend got a little haircut? Saying "Did you get a haircut? It looks good" makes people happy.

ISFP>ENTJ.title: Someone who decides quickly, then worries about how it sounded.
ISFP>ENTJ.body: After clearly setting how the team will work, you calm down alone listening to music you love. You divide up the work without hesitation, but before sending an email, you reread it many times to make sure the words aren't harsh.
ISFP>ENTJ.say: "The deadline's the end of the month. Let's stop here today and take a break."
ISFP>ENTJ.do: You plan your whole move quickly, but spend a week choosing curtains.
ISFP>ENTJ.do_s: You plan the school festival quickly, but spend a week choosing your own costume.
ISFP>ENTJ.worry: The more you lead, the less time you have to enjoy things alone. After you say something firmly, you keep wondering if you hurt the other person.
ISFP>ENTJ.karai: When it comes to where to eat lunch, you always let someone else decide.
ISFP>ENTJ.aru: On the night after a meeting where you made quick decisions, you replay it: "Was I too harsh?"
ISFP>ENTJ.aru_s: On the night after a club meeting where you made quick decisions, you replay it: "Was I too harsh?"
ISFP>ENTJ.why: By nature, you're the type who settles down alone and values your own and other people's feelings. Through experience, you also came to stand in front of people, decide with logic, and move plans forward. All four letters are different, so what's on your mind changes a lot between the you who decides and the you who's alone. When deciding, you can state things firmly with logic, but once you've settled down alone, you worry about how the other person took it and keep replaying that moment.
ISFP>ENTJ.yure: All four letters are different, so your result may change each time. Answer as yourself at work, and you may get a leader type. Answer as yourself relaxing at home, and you may get a quiet type.
ISFP>ENTJ.yure_s: All four letters are different, so your result may change each time. Answer as yourself leading your club or a group project, and you may get a leader type. Answer as yourself relaxing at home, and you may get a quiet type.
ISFP>ENTJ.plus: It stays on your mind because you really look at people's faces. A leader who decides clearly and then adds a kind word is easy for everyone to follow.
ISFP>ENTJ.tip: On days you had to say something tough, end with "Thanks for today." It also helps to say hi to them first the next day.
ISFP>ENTJ.hidden: Does putting a single flower in your room change your mood? Your temperament enjoys colors and textures right in front of you. Use it, and you can lift your own mood even on busy days.

ISFP>ENTP.title: Someone who turns a heart-to-heart into a fun chat.
ISFP>ENTP.body: When you're talking at a café, the topic keeps changing, and you end up laughing about something completely different. You were supposed to be talking about a movie you love, and somehow it turns into, "If we filmed one ourselves, how would we do it?"
ISFP>ENTP.say: "I get it, that sounds rough. Okay, let's come up with a plan."
ISFP>ENTP.do: When friends can't agree on a place to eat, you say "Okay, how about this?" and suggest something else.
ISFP>ENTP.worry: The more fun you have talking, the more tired you get later, and you want to be alone. On nights after you said too much, you keep replaying it and thinking about how they felt.
ISFP>ENTP.karai: Your travel plan is "let's decide when we get there," and it usually works out.
ISFP>ENTP.aru: When a friend says they don't fit in at work, you suggest, "Why not invite someone to lunch?" and you both end up laughing.
ISFP>ENTP.aru_s: When a friend says they don't fit in with their new class, you suggest, "Why not invite someone to lunch?" and you both end up laughing.
ISFP>ENTP.why: By nature, you're the type who spends time quietly alone and chooses by feeling. Through all kinds of experiences, you also got good at coming up with ideas while talking with people and thinking with logic. Moving with the flow of the moment has been you from the start. You can take in someone's pain with your feelings while also working out a plan to make things better, so by the end of the conversation, laughter comes out.
ISFP>ENTP.yure: Your answers about people, how you see things, and how you decide can all change, so your result can shift a lot. Answer as yourself chatting with people, and you'll lean toward a talkative type. Answer as yourself alone with your favorite things, and you'll lean toward a quiet type.
ISFP>ENTP.plus: A heart-to-heart turns fun because you're kind and full of ideas. People feel better after talking with you.
ISFP>ENTP.tip: Before you suggest a plan, ask them first, "What do you want to do?" If you work from their answer, you'll say too much less often.
ISFP>ENTP.hidden: You like walking home alone with music, thinking back on the day's conversations. That's your temperament's way of enjoying quiet time alone. With that time, you can happily pick things up next time with, "About what we talked about last time..."

ISFP>INFJ.title: Someone who worries about their friends' future, too.
ISFP>INFJ.body: On days a friend looks tired, you bring them a warm drink without asking anything. You put friends' important days in your phone calendar, and send a short message the day before: "It's tomorrow, right?"
ISFP>INFJ.say: "Don't worry, I'm not bothered about earlier."
ISFP>INFJ.do: When you buy clothes, you think about whether you'll still wear them next year.
ISFP>INFJ.worry: You think about others so much that your own feelings get pushed back. Even on days you want to follow your mood, you fill your schedule "for the future."
ISFP>INFJ.karai: You'll listen to other people's problems for hours, but you haven't told anyone about yours.
ISFP>INFJ.aru: When a friend says, "I have an interview next month," you worry about it from that day on as if it were your own.
ISFP>INFJ.why: By nature, you're the type who enjoys the moment and moves with your mood. As you've gotten older, you also came to think ahead and prepare in advance. Recharging in time alone and valuing people's feelings are the same now. Imagining what's ahead has been added to your ability to stay close to people's feelings, so your feelings get caught up even in a friend's interview day.
ISFP>INFJ.yure: Whether you're in a stretch of helping friends with problems or just taking it easy can change your answers on "facts or ideas" and "plan or go with the flow." Even if your result changes, both are you.
ISFP>INFJ.plus: You worry about what's ahead because you really care about that person. Your words help hold them up.
ISFP>INFJ.tip: When you're worried, just send "Let me know if anything comes up." If you don't jump ahead too much, it's easier for them to come to you.
ISFP>INFJ.hidden: On a nice day, you feel like taking the long way home for no reason. That's your temperament's way of following your mood. You usually think ahead, so this hasn't come out much yet. Follow your mood sometimes, and time with friends will feel more relaxed.

ISFP>INFP.title: Someone who stops to look at flowers by the road.
ISFP>INFP.body: When you see a house from the train window, you wonder, "What kind of person lives there?" When you finish a story you love, you sometimes imagine what happens next and write it down in a notebook.
ISFP>INFP.say: "Just hearing that makes me want to cry."
ISFP>INFP.do: After watching a movie you love, you keep thinking about it for days.
ISFP>INFP.worry: When a trip or birthday you were looking forward to turns out even a little different from what you pictured, you feel sad. You care about so many things that you can't pick one.
ISFP>INFP.karai: "Anything's fine" is your go-to line, but you've already picked a first choice in your head.
ISFP>INFP.aru: You go for a walk listening to your favorite songs, and before you know it you're on a street you don't know.
ISFP>INFP.why: By nature, you're the type who takes in the colors and sounds in front of you. Through all kinds of experiences, you also came to like imagining things you haven't seen yet. Valuing time alone and moving the way your feelings lead have always been you. When you listen to music you love, your imagination spreads in your head, and your attention drifts there more than to the road under your feet.
ISFP>INFP.yure: Only the "facts or ideas" question tends to change. Answer as yourself making something, or as yourself lost in thought, and you may go back and forth between two types.
ISFP>INFP.plus: You have high ideals because you know clearly what matters to you. It shows how carefully you take things in.
ISFP>INFP.tip: When you find a pretty view, take a photo and send it to a friend. Just getting "Nice!" back helps you trust the way you see things.
ISFP>INFP.hidden: Your temperament is good at checking how things feel and look. It shows when you pick up a gift again and again and know, "This one's the best." Use it, and you'll be able to actually make the things you imagine.

ISFP>ENFJ.title: Someone who listens, then helps you figure out what to do next.
ISFP>ENFJ.body: When a younger teammate comes to you for advice, you first listen all the way to the end, then say, "Okay, let's try this first." After that, the next week you're the one who asks, "How's it been since then?"
ISFP>ENFJ.say: "I'll hear you out. Then we'll figure it out together."
ISFP>ENFJ.do: When a friend passes an exam, you invite them out to celebrate right away.
ISFP>ENFJ.worry: When you keep being the one who cheers others on, you lose time for yourself and get tired. Some days your mood doesn't match the plans you made for everyone.
ISFP>ENFJ.karai: While listening to a friend vent, you end up closer to tears than they are.
ISFP>ENFJ.aru: You went to drop off snacks for a friend who was feeling down, and by the time you left, you'd set next week's goal together.
ISFP>ENFJ.why: By nature, you're the type who settles down alone and moves freely while enjoying the moment. Through experience, you also came to step in among people to encourage them, look ahead, and set up the steps. Valuing people's feelings hasn't changed since the start. When you see a friend who's feeling down, your wish for them to feel better grows strong, and you want to think through the next step with them.
ISFP>ENFJ.yure: Your result can change a lot depending on which "you" you picture. Answer as yourself cheering others on, and you may get a leader type. Answer as yourself doing what you love alone, and you may get a quiet type.
ISFP>ENFJ.plus: You get tired because you do so much for other people. Not many people listen and then help you think about what comes next.
ISFP>ENFJ.tip: While you're planning for others, pick one "treat day" for yourself and put it on your calendar. If it's there first, other people's plans won't push it out.
ISFP>ENFJ.hidden: Just putting on music you love and spacing out in your room brings your energy back. That's your temperament's way of calming down alone. Make time for it, and you'll be able to keep being kind to others.

ISFP>ENFP.title: Someone who tells friends right away when they find something good.
ISFP>ENFP.body: When you find cute little things, you end up buying one for yourself and one for a friend. On days off, you head out to look for small shops in towns you've never been to.
ISFP>ENFP.say: "Saw this and thought of you, so I'm sending it."
ISFP>ENFP.do: When you spot a shop that catches your eye, you walk in, even on your own.
ISFP>ENFP.worry: On the way home from a fun time with people, you suddenly want to be alone. You keep finding new things you love and move on before sticking with one.
ISFP>ENFP.karai: You come home with clothes you didn't plan to buy because "I love this color."
ISFP>ENFP.aru: The week after enjoying your favorite café alone, you bring three friends there.
ISFP>ENFP.why: By nature, you're the type who quietly enjoys the comfort in front of you, alone. Through all kinds of experiences, you also came to have fun with people and look for new places. Choosing by feeling and acting on the spot have been you from the start. The things you savored alone and confirmed as good are the ones you most want to share with the people you love.
ISFP>ENFP.yure: After a weekend out with friends, or after a lazy day at home? Depending on when you take it, your answers on "people or alone" and "facts or ideas" can change, and so can your result.
ISFP>ENFP.plus: You want to be alone on the way home because you want to think back on the fun. Having time alone is what lets you enjoy time with people.
ISFP>ENFP.tip: When you make plans to go out, block off half the next day for yourself. It's okay to turn down invites with a simple "Today's my alone day."
ISFP>ENFP.hidden: Do you lose track of time wandering a bookstore alone? Your temperament can enjoy things slowly by yourself. Make time for it, and the way you recommend things to people will get even more fun.

ISFP>ISTJ.title: Someone serious who sticks to what they decided.
ISFP>ISTJ.body: Your desk at work is always neatly tidied, with a small plant in the corner. You leave home at the same time every morning, but when seasonal flowers are blooming on your way to work, you can't help stopping to take a photo.
ISFP>ISTJ.body_s: Your study desk is always neatly tidied, with a small plant in the corner. You leave home at the same time every morning, but when seasonal flowers are blooming on your way to school, you can't help stopping to take a photo.
ISFP>ISTJ.say: "I'll hand it in by the deadline. I just picked colors I like."
ISFP>ISTJ.do: You get up at the same time every morning and take the same road to work.
ISFP>ISTJ.do_s: You get up at the same time every morning and take the same road to school.
ISFP>ISTJ.worry: On nights after you decided with logic, you wonder if you ignored how the other person felt. Some days, while you're following the rules, what you like gets put on hold.
ISFP>ISTJ.karai: Even on a trip, you end up buying your usual rice ball at the usual convenience store.
ISFP>ISTJ.aru: You track your monthly spending down to the last cent in an app, but when you see a cute pen at a stationery store, you buy it anyway.
ISFP>ISTJ.why: By nature, you're the type who chooses by feeling and moves freely. Through experience, you also came to decide with logic and stick to what you've decided. Recharging in time alone and thinking based on past experience are the same now. You can stick to how you've decided to manage money, but the moment you feel "That's cute" in front of something, your original feeling of choosing what you love moves first.
ISFP>ISTJ.yure: Your answers tend to change on "logic or feelings" and "plan or go with the flow." Answer as yourself at work, or as yourself browsing gift shops on a day off, and you may get a different result.
ISFP>ISTJ.yure_s: Your answers tend to change on "logic or feelings" and "plan or go with the flow." Answer as yourself in class, or as yourself browsing gift shops on a day off, and you may get a different result.
ISFP>ISTJ.plus: You end up buying it because you care about the "so cute, I love it" feeling. People feel at ease around someone who is careful and also knows how to have fun.
ISFP>ISTJ.tip: In your monthly budget, set aside a little money just for things you love. As long as you stay within it, you can enjoy cute things without feeling bad.
ISFP>ISTJ.hidden: On days a coworker seems down, you leave a snack on their desk without asking anything. That's your temperament's way of noticing how people feel. Show it more, and you'll be someone people find easy to talk to.
ISFP>ISTJ.hidden_s: On days a classmate seems down, you leave a snack on their desk without asking anything. That's your temperament's way of noticing how people feel. Show it more, and you'll be someone people find easy to talk to.

ISFP>ISFJ.title: Someone who always gets things ready for others.
ISFP>ISFJ.body: For family birthdays, you think about gifts weeks in advance. You keep notes on things they once said they liked, and choose from those.
ISFP>ISFJ.say: "You said you liked this before, right?"
ISFP>ISFJ.do: At the supermarket, you look around to see if your family's favorite foods are on sale.
ISFP>ISFJ.do_s: At the convenience store, you look around for new flavors of your family's favorite snacks.
ISFP>ISFJ.worry: The more you prepare, the more you feel a little guilty about taking it easy. While fitting into other people's plans, you often forget what you wanted to do.
ISFP>ISFJ.karai: You remember other people's plans, but often forget your own.
ISFP>ISFJ.aru: You make your family's lunches the night before, but on your own days out, you wander wherever your mood takes you.
ISFP>ISFJ.aru_s: You wrap your friend's birthday present neatly the night before, but on your own days out, you wander wherever your mood takes you.
ISFP>ISFJ.why: By nature, you're the type who moves with your mood. As you've gotten older, you also came to think ahead and prepare properly. Recharging in time alone and valuing people's feelings have always been you. Your ability to prepare works best when you want someone to be happy, so with errands that are just for you, your original easygoing side is still there as it was.
ISFP>ISFJ.yure: Only the "plan or go with the flow" question tends to change. Answer as yourself on a day helping your family, and you'll lean toward planning. Answer as yourself on a free day alone, and you'll lean toward going with the flow.
ISFP>ISFJ.plus: You feel bad about relaxing because you think of others first. The way you prepare helps the people around you.
ISFP>ISFJ.tip: Think of your detours as "today's treat" and enjoy them without guilt. Getting things ready only for others wears you out, so it's okay to care about your own fun too.
ISFP>ISFJ.hidden: Even when rain suddenly changes your plans, you switch right away: "Okay, let's watch a movie at home." That's your temperament's way of enjoying the moment. Use it, and even days that don't go as planned can be fun.

ISFP>ESTJ.title: You like to set the turns and the order ahead of time.
ISFP>ESTJ.body: After setting the work schedule precisely, you ask anyone who looks tired, "Are you okay?" You set the duty rotation precisely, but if someone has something come up, you quietly swap their turn with yours.
ISFP>ESTJ.body_s: After setting the group project schedule precisely, you ask anyone who looks tired, "Are you okay?" You set the cleaning duty rotation precisely, but if a classmate has something come up, you quietly swap their turn with yours.
ISFP>ESTJ.say: "Let's go with what worked last time."
ISFP>ESTJ.do: You always clean the house on Sunday morning, and when you're done, you put out some flowers.
ISFP>ESTJ.do_s: You always clean your room on Sunday morning, and when you're done, you put some flowers on your desk.
ISFP>ESTJ.worry: On days you spoke firmly, you can't sleep because you wonder if you were too harsh. When you lead for a long time, you start wanting time alone for the things you love.
ISFP>ESTJ.karai: On days you had to be strict, you buy something cute on the way home.
ISFP>ESTJ.aru: After sending the chore schedule to the group chat, you reread it every time someone sees it: "Did that sound cold?"
ISFP>ESTJ.why: By nature, you're the type who settles down alone and values feelings. Through experience, you also came to bring people together and decide the order with logic. Thinking based on past experience hasn't changed since the start. You can decide things with logic, but how the people who received it felt has always mattered to you, so every time a message shows as read, you check your wording again.
ISFP>ESTJ.yure: Apart from "facts," all three other parts are different, so your result can change a lot. Answer as yourself leading, and you'll lean toward an organized type. Answer as yourself on a day off, and you'll lean toward a quiet type.
ISFP>ESTJ.plus: You have nights where you worry about how you said things because you care about people. That kindness is why people still follow you even when you're direct.
ISFP>ESTJ.tip: When you ask someone to do something, add "Just ask if anything's unclear" at the end. You'll have fewer nights worrying about how you said it.
ISFP>ESTJ.hidden: On a busy day, stopping at a café alone for a warm drink on the way home helps you relax. That's your temperament's way of calming down alone. Make time for it on purpose, and you'll stay kind the next day too.

ISFP>ESFJ.title: Someone who keeps an eye on whether everyone's plate is empty.
ISFP>ESFJ.body: For a friend's birthday, you reach out to everyone and set up a celebration. You reserve the cake the week before, and on the day you even do the decorations.
ISFP>ESFJ.do: When you hear a friend has a cold, you buy their favorite drink and drop it off.
ISFP>ESFJ.worry: You like doing things for everyone, but if it goes on too long, you suddenly want to be alone. When you turn down an invite, you worry too much about letting them down.
ISFP>ESFJ.karai: At the register, you say "thank you" more times than the clerk does.
ISFP>ESFJ.aru: At a hot pot party, you keep busy adding food and passing plates the whole time. But when they invite you to the next place, you smile, say "Next time," and head home.
ISFP>ESFJ.aru_s: At the class party, you keep busy handing out snacks and picking up trash the whole time. But when they invite you to karaoke after, you smile, say "Next time," and head home.
ISFP>ESFJ.why: By nature, you're the type who spends time quietly alone and moves with your mood. Through experience, you also came to look out for people and prepare far ahead. Valuing people's feelings has been you from the start. During a get-together you use up all your energy on everyone, so you turn down the invite afterward with a smile and want to get back to time alone.
ISFP>ESFJ.yure: Your answers tend to change on "energy from people" and "plan or go with the flow." Your result may differ between busy weeks of planning events and quiet weeks at home.
ISFP>ESFJ.plus: You skip the next place because you've been on the go for everyone the whole time. You can head home before you get worn out because you know yourself well.
ISFP>ESFJ.plus_s: You skip karaoke because you've been on the go for everyone the whole time. You can head home before you get worn out because you know yourself well.
ISFP>ESFJ.tip: When you say no to an invite, just add "Let's catch up properly next time." If there's a next time in sight, they won't feel let down.
ISFP>ESFJ.hidden: Your temperament knows how to follow your mood. It shows when, on a free day, you hop on a train on a whim and walk around a town you don't know. You're usually busy preparing, so this hasn't come out much yet. Head out like this sometimes, and you'll wear yourself out less from over-preparing.

ISFP>ISTP.title: Someone who fixes up old things with their own hands.
ISFP>ISTP.body: When you see an old chair and think "That's nice," you've already got the sandpaper. You pick colors and shapes at a glance, but when fixing it, you look at how the wood is cracked and how deep the scratches are, and think of the repair that will last the longest.
ISFP>ISTP.say: "I'll figure it out as I go."
ISFP>ISTP.do: For a friend's birthday, you make sweets you think they'll like.
ISFP>ISTP.worry: After saying something true very directly, you keep replaying it, worried you hurt them. Some days, even when you get a present, you think "Will I actually use this?" first and can't just enjoy it.
ISFP>ISTP.karai: You don't care much about clothes, but you're very picky about the tools you use.
ISFP>ISTP.aru: While shopping with a friend, you said, "That might not really suit you." After you split up, you look up clothes that would suit them and send photos.
ISFP>ISTP.why: By nature, you're the type who decides by feeling and by what you like. Through all kinds of experiences, you also came to think with logic and speak clearly. Moving alone while checking what's in front of you is the same now. You can honestly say when you think something doesn't suit someone, but your wish to make them happy has always been strong, so after you part ways you end up looking for clothes that would suit them.
ISFP>ISTP.yure: The only difference is "logic or feelings." Answer as yourself fixing or making something, and you'll lean toward logic. Answer as yourself thinking about someone you care about, and you'll lean toward feelings.
ISFP>ISTP.plus: You keep replaying it later because you care about their feelings too. You may seem blunt, but the photos you send later show how you really feel.
ISFP>ISTP.tip: After giving a direct opinion, add "But I get how you feel." On days the words won't come, a small handmade thing can say it for you.
ISFP>ISTP.hidden: When choosing clothes or little things, you can tell right away, "These two go together." That's your temperament's feel for mood and style. Use it, and you'll get even better at picking gifts.

ISFP>ISFP.title: You know clearly what you love.
ISFP>ISFP.body: Even if you can't put the reason into words, you know clearly what feels right to you. From the curtains in your room to your dishes, you've collected only things in colors that calm you, little by little. You feel at ease surrounded by things you love, and being rushed tends to tire you out a little.
ISFP>ISFP.say: "Yeah, this one. I can't really say why."
ISFP>ISFP.do: On the way home, you notice the smell of the season and take the long way.
ISFP>ISFP.worry: It takes you time to say how you feel, so you often end up keeping it in. When rushed days keep coming, you lose even the energy to do what you love.
ISFP>ISFP.karai: When you find a song you love, you play nothing else for a week, then one day you stop completely.
ISFP>ISFP.aru: You told your friend "Anywhere's fine," but you're still thinking about the place you didn't go all the way home.
ISFP>ISFP.why: Your temperament and character are the same in all four letters: by nature, you're the type who settles down alone and values your own feelings. Even with all kinds of experiences, that has hardly changed. You're not very good at pushing what you like on others. Even when you go along with someone and say "Anywhere is fine," the feeling inside that "I'd have liked the other one" doesn't go away, so it stays with you all the way home.
ISFP>ISFP.yure: You'll likely get the same result every time. If a different type shows up, you may be too busy to go at your own pace, or working hard to fit in with others.
ISFP>ISFP.plus: You remember the place that wasn't picked because you care about what you like. When everyone's stuck, your "This one's good" often settles it.
ISFP>ISFP.tip: When you're about to say "Anywhere's fine," try a small "If I had to pick, this one." That's enough practice for saying what you feel.
ISFP>ISFP.hidden: You often follow your mood, but you can also look ahead and prepare. It shows when you get concert tickets for a singer you love right on the release day. Use it a little more, and the things you want to do won't stay stuck at "someday."

ISFP>ESTP.title: When plans fall through, you find something else right away.
ISFP>ESTP.body: On trips, you turn down any street that catches your interest, and if a shop is crowded, you look for the next one right away. Even when plans with friends fall through, you come up with another idea on the spot and message everyone right away.
ISFP>ESTP.say: "This place has such a nice vibe! Let's go in!"
ISFP>ESTP.do: When a shop catches your eye on the street, you just walk in.
ISFP>ESTP.worry: Later you wonder if you thought about your friend's feelings when you decided on a whim. After a long stretch of lively time, you suddenly feel wiped out.
ISFP>ESTP.karai: You decide on dinner by what's cheap at the supermarket, but toss snacks in the basket without checking the price.
ISFP>ESTP.karai_s: You decide on lunch by what's cheap at the convenience store, but grab snacks without checking the price.
ISFP>ESTP.aru: The moment rain cancels your plans, you find a museum nearby and say "Let's go!" to everyone. On the way home, you worry, "Maybe someone didn't want to go."
ISFP>ESTP.why: By nature, you're the type who enjoys things quietly alone and chooses by feeling. Through experience, you also came to lead people and decide quickly with logic. Looking at what's in front of you and acting on the spot have always been you. In the moment, you quickly pick an idea everyone can enjoy, and once you're alone on the way home, you want to check whether everyone really wanted to do that.
ISFP>ESTP.yure: Answer as yourself on a day out with friends, and you'll get an action type. Answer as yourself on a quiet day alone, and you'll get a quieter type. You may get stuck on "people or alone" and "logic or feelings," so your result can change.
ISFP>ESTP.plus: You get quiet on the way home because you're thinking back on the fun and how everyone felt. Someone who acts fast and thinks of others afterward is fun to be around.
ISFP>ESTP.tip: When you decide on the spot, add "Tell me if you'd rather go somewhere else." That alone means less worrying on the way home.
ISFP>ESTP.hidden: When you walk alone, do you notice the smell of the season or the color of the sky? Your temperament can enjoy things quietly by yourself. Use it, and even a walk on your own can turn up nice shops and views.

ISFP>ESFP.title: Someone who shares good food with everyone.
ISFP>ESFP.body: The day after you make a friend's birthday a blast, you watch a movie alone in your room. When you find a new café, you invite friends to go, but the next time, you go alone to sit in the seat you liked.
ISFP>ESFP.say: "This is so good! Everyone, try it!"
ISFP>ESFP.do: When you're out with friends, you drop into any shop that catches your eye.
ISFP>ESFP.worry: The more fun you have, the more tired you are later. You can't say no to invites, so you often run short on time alone.
ISFP>ESFP.karai: You're the one who says "Let's hang out again!" most, yet the next message usually comes from them.
ISFP>ESFP.aru: You get chatting with the staff at a free-sample stand and end up buying the snack. Back home, eating it slowly by yourself is the best part.
ISFP>ESFP.why: By nature, you're the type who recharges by resting alone. Through experience, you also came to get energy from time spent having fun with people. Savoring what's in front of you and moving the way your feelings lead haven't changed since the start. Time spent talking with people is for spreading the fun, and after you get home, it becomes time to slowly savor that fun again on your own.
ISFP>ESFP.yure: In a busy social stretch you may get an outgoing type, and in a stretch with lots of alone time, a quieter one. Just the "energy from people" question can move you between two types.
ISFP>ESFP.plus: You make friends fast and enjoy your alone time too. You share the fun with people, so everyone wants to hang out with you again.
ISFP>ESFP.tip: When you say "Let's hang out again," pick a date right then. It won't just be talk, and they'll be happy you really meant it.
ISFP>ESFP.hidden: Your temperament can get quietly lost in something alone. It shows when you're cooking by yourself and suddenly hours have passed. Use it, and you'll do more than have fun. You'll build skills you can show people.
